definitions.explanation: Thin shavings of dried, fermented, and smoked skipjack tuna, used for making dashi and as a topping.

notes:
{鰹節|かつおぶし} is skipjack tuna that has been boiled, smoked and dried, often also cured with mold, until it is one of the hardest foods there is. It is shaved into flakes for ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ and as a topping; at home the flakes are often called おかか.

TYPES:
- {荒節|あらぶし}: smoked and dried, no mold
- {枯節|かれぶし}: also cured with mold; richer flavor
- {本枯節|ほんかれぶし}: mold-cured several times; premium
- ⟦{削|けず}り{節|ぶし}→削り節：11909_kezuribushi⟧: ready-shaved flakes sold in packs
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧{削|けず}り: fine threads, used as a garnish
- {厚|あつ}{削|けず}り: thick shavings for long-simmered dashi

USAGE:
On hot food such as ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧, the thin flakes curl and sway in the rising heat, so they are said to ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ (dance).
